items.detail: The **Nasdaq** sank **2.60%** to 26,008.86 Thursday, its steepest drop since June, dragging the S&P 500 down 1.21% to 7,663.43.
items.why: Meta fell nearly 7% after posting its first cash outflow in over a decade, reviving fears about AI spending.

items.detail: Chip stocks led the rout, with the **Philadelphia Semiconductor Index** down **6.72%** and AMD off 8.1%, while Tesla slid 3.1% despite surprise positive free cash flow.
items.why: A supply warning from Lam Research hit chipmakers already under pressure from doubts about AI payoffs.

items.detail: With the **Fed** meeting next week on October 27–28, Brent near **$112** is keeping a later rate hike firmly on the table.
items.why: Reports of planned new strikes on Iran pushed oil to its highest since May, stoking inflation fears.

items.detail: South Korea's **Kospi** fell more than **4%** early Friday, briefly touching the 5,300 level, after closing Thursday down 3.52% at 5,533.77.
items.why: The US chip selloff over AI costs hit Samsung and SK Hynix, which foreigners have been dumping all month.

items.detail: The **Nifty** fell 0.54% to **22,687.65** Thursday, a third straight loss, while the Sensex lost 460 points to 73,249.39.
items.why: Crude above $110 and weak Asian markets sparked broad selling, with IT, energy and FMCG among the worst sectors.

items.detail: The US **Russell 2000** edged up **0.11%** to 2,784.03 Thursday, staying positive while the Nasdaq dropped 2.6%.
items.why: Investors running from AI megacaps moved into smaller US companies that have little exposure to chip spending.

items.detail: **Bitcoin** slid about **3.3%** to roughly $81,400 early Friday, wiping out this week's calm and testing key support near $81,500.
items.why: The tech selloff dragged crypto down with it, even after spot bitcoin ETFs took in about $1.08 billion over three sessions.

items.detail: **Ether** fell back below $2,500, dropping about **3.6%** to around $2,381 Thursday and losing more than bitcoin.
items.why: ETH tends to swing harder with tech stocks, and the steady drain from Ether ETFs leaves little buying support.

items.detail: **Solana** fell about **3.3%** to near $103 Thursday, giving up its post-Alpenglow level around $106.
items.why: Broad risk-off selling across crypto outweighed any lift from the faster network upgrade.

items.detail: **Gold** broke below $4,100 and fell about **2.6%** to near $4,033 Thursday, wiping out Wednesday's rebound and heading for an October loss.
items.why: Brent near $112 boosted inflation fears and bets on a Fed hike, while yields stayed near 5.1%.

crossCuttingTheme: Meta's AI-spending shock sent chip stocks, Korea and crypto lower together, while Brent near $112 kept Fed hike bets alive, hurting gold and India and leaving only US small caps standing.
